name: com.nekosune.world-ui-assistant
description: Build VRChat world UI without knowing Unity UI: a New panel wizard with themes, one-click widgets, pages with Back buttons, and button/toggle actions (show/hide, mirror, sound, teleport, open page, Udon event; local or synced) wired through a small readable UdonSharp script. Plain-English editing explains the Unity components behind each part. Open via NekoSune → World → UI Assistant.
